For the Fund, this spread widening led to unrealized losses from fair value adjustments (not permanent impairment of capital), even though overall credit performance of the portfolio remained solid.  Approximately 100% of the Fund&#8217;s investment portfolio at fair value, or $243 million, was rated in the Fund&#8217;s highest Internal Performance Rating</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:6.47pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%;position:relative;top:-3.48pt;vertical-align:baseline">1</span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%"> (&#8220;IPR&#8221;) categories, IPR 4 and IPR 5. As of March 31, 2026, the fair value of the Fund&#8217;s IPR 4 and IPR 5 debt investments as a percentage of outstanding principal (&#8220;Average Price&#8221;) declined to 98.2%, compared to 99.9% as of December 31, 2025. Net unrealized losses resulting from this decline in Average Price of the Fund&#8217;s IPR 4 and IPR 5 debt investments are estimated to have contributed approximately 100% of the decrease in the Fund&#8217;s NAV per share from $25.00 as of December 31, 2025 to $24.10 as of  March&#160;31, 2026. </span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">As of  March&#160;31, 2026, IPR 3 investments represented less than 0.01% of the Fund&#8217;s investment portfolio at fair value, with no investments rated in the IPR 1 or IPR 2 categories. </span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">End Notes</span></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:115%"> </span></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:6.5pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;position:relative;top:-3.5pt;vertical-align:baseline">1 </span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">As part of our monitoring process, GC Advisors regularly assesses the risk profile of each of the Fund&#8217;s investments and rates each of them based on an internal system developed by Golub Capital and its affiliates. The borrower is performing above expectations, and the trends and risk factors are generally favorable.</span></td></tr><tr><td colspan="3" style="padding:2px 1pt;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">4</span></td><td colspan="3" style="padding:0 1pt"/><td colspan="3" style="padding:2px 1pt;text-align:left;vertical-align:top"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Involves an acceptable level of risk that is similar to the risk at the time of origination. The borrower is generally performing as expected, and the risk factors are neutral to favorable.</span></td></tr><tr><td colspan="3" style="padding:2px 1pt;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">3</span></td><td colspan="3" style="padding:0 1pt"/><td colspan="3" style="padding:2px 1pt;text-align:left;vertical-align:top"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Involves a borrower performing below expectations and indicates that the loan&#8217;s risk has increased somewhat since origination. Most or all of the debt covenants are out of compliance and payments are substantially delinquent. Loans rated 1 are not anticipated to be repaid in full and we will reduce the fair market value of the loan to the amount we anticipate will be recovered.</span></td></tr></table></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Our internal performance ratings do not constitute any rating of investments by a nationally recognized statistical rating organization or represent or reflect any third-party assessment of any of our investments.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">For any investment rated 1, 2 or 3, GC Advisors will increase its monitoring intensity and prepare regular updates for the investment committee, summarizing current operating results and material impending events and suggesting recommended actions.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">GC Advisors monitors and, when appropriate, changes the internal performance ratings assigned to each investment in the Fund&#8217;s portfolio.
